summary: Readable and mostly natural Dutch, but the weakest vocabulary layer of the three versions: one unglossed B2 word with a plain equivalent (universeel), the stretch budget doubled, and six glosses spent on known words while brein, geest, planeten and the glossary term Faunaat-transformatie go unglossed. All six grammar flags are false positives; the one L-FRAME load finding stands.

findings.fragment: de echte wetten waren perfect universeel
findings.problem: 'universeel' is a hard (B2) word, unglossed, and a plain phrase with the same meaning exists.
findings.evidence: lexicon status hard (B2), action replace-or-gloss; V2 and V3 render the same idea with known words
findings.required_fix: Replace 'perfect universeel' with 'overal precies hetzelfde': 'De echte wetten waren overal precies hetzelfde.' (combine with L13).

findings.fragment: Een menselijke geest kan zich niet zomaar de hele anatomie van een kat voorstellen, en, en alle biochemie van een kat, en hoe zit het met de neurologie?
findings.problem: The verbal frame holds 9 words between 'kan' and 'voorstellen', and the stammered list continues after the closing verb, so the reader carries the open frame through the whole object.
findings.required_fix: Close the frame early and hang the list on a colon: 'Een menselijke geest kan zich dat niet zomaar voorstellen: de hele anatomie van een kat, en, en alle biochemie van een kat, en hoe zit het met de \emph{neurologie}?'

findings.fragment: landde … gestreepte … weggooit … signalen … melodie … steun
findings.problem: Six unglossed B1 words against a stretch budget of 3 for this scene length.
findings.evidence: lexicon stretch (B1): landen (b024), steun (b024), gestreept (b025, tool lemmatised it as 'streepen'), weggooien (b028), signaal (b028), melodie (b032); budget 3
findings.required_fix: Replace the least useful ones with known words: 'landde' → 'viel'; 'de kleine gestreepte kat' → 'de kleine kat met strepen'; 'Als je die wet weggooit' → 'Als je die wet niet accepteert'; 'signalen sneller dan het licht' → 'berichten sneller dan het licht'; 'dezelfde melodie als' → 'hetzelfde liedje als'. Keep 'steun'.

findings.fragment: Als je die wet weggooit, maak je de unitariteit kapot, en dan krijg je signalen sneller dan het licht!
findings.problem: Three new words in one sentence (weggooien, unitariteit, signaal); only 'unitariteit' is the deliberate jargon.
findings.required_fix: Apply the replacements in L3 ('niet accepteert', 'berichten') so only the intended jargon word remains new.

findings.fragment: de muziek van de planeten was dezelfde melodie als een vallende appel
findings.problem: Two new words in one sentence: 'planeet' (B2, unglossed) and 'melodie' (B1).
findings.evidence: cluster b032 (sentence): melodie, planeet; lexicon planeet hard (B2), action replace-or-gloss
findings.required_fix: 'planeten' has no plain equivalent ('sterren' changes the meaning): keep and gloss '\gl{planeten}{planets}'; replace 'melodie' with 'liedje': 'de muziek van de \gl{planeten}{planets} was hetzelfde liedje als een vallende appel.'

findings.fragment: met een brein zo klein als dat van een kat
findings.problem: 'brein' is not in any lexicon list and occurs five times unglossed; it carries the mind = brain point of b032.
findings.evidence: vocab row brein: unknown, n=5, b028 b032, action review
findings.required_fix: Gloss at the first occurrence: 'met een \gl{brein}{brain} zo klein als dat van een kat'. Lexicon owner: add 'brein' as a transparent cognate.

findings.problem: 'geest' is known to the reader only as ghost/spirit; here it means mind, and nothing in the sentence signals that sense.
findings.evidence: lexicon geest: known A2, en = ghost, spirit; V2 and V3 gloss it as 'mind'
findings.required_fix: Gloss the sense: 'Een menselijke \gl{geest}{mind}'. The paragraph stays within 2 glosses once the two unnecessary ones (L9) are dropped.

findings.fragment: Een Faunaat-transformatie, dat is de precieze naam.
findings.problem: Glossary term at its first occurrence in the chapter, left unglossed; 'Faunaat' is opaque to the reader.
findings.evidence: glossary.json: 'An Animagus transformation' = 'een Faunaat-transformatie'; vocab row faunaat-transformatie unknown; V2 and V3 gloss it
findings.required_fix: Gloss the whole compound: 'Een \gl{Faunaat-transformatie}{Animagus transformation}, dat is de precieze naam.'

findings.problem: Thirteen glosses on 394 words, six of them on words the reader already knows; the gloss slots are needed elsewhere (L5, L6, L7, L8).
findings.evidence: lexicon: aarzelen A2, steek A2, overtreden A2, willekeurig A2, uitzondering known (B1 path word), beslissend = regular derivation of beslissen A2
findings.required_fix: Drop these six glosses (b022 beslissend, aarzelde; b024 steek; b028 overtreden, willekeurige; b032 uitzondering) and remove them from @glosses.

findings.problem: 'wazig' is unknown and needs a gloss, while the known noun 'waas' says the same thing without one.
findings.evidence: vocab row wazig: unknown, glossed; lexicon waas: known A2 (haze, mist)
findings.required_fix: 'Er kwam een waas voor Harry's ogen.' (as V3) and drop the gloss.

findings.problem: Word-for-word 'You can't do that'; in Dutch 'Dat kunt u niet doen' reads first as a moral prohibition (you mustn't), not as 'that is impossible', and the emphasis on 'doen' strengthens that reading.
findings.evidence: EN: 'You can't do that!' (impossibility, cf. b028 'You violated Conservation of Energy') vs NL: 'Dat kunt u niet doen!' (prohibition)
findings.required_fix: Drop 'doen' and move the emphasis to the modal: '“\emph{Dat \emph{kunt} u niet!}”' (as V3).

findings.fragment: Het hele idee van een universum als één geheel, met wiskundig regelmatige wetten, dat spoelde nu weg door de wc; het hele idee van \emph{natuurkunde}.
findings.problem: Legal but heavy: a 23-word sentence whose topic carries two post-modifiers before the resumptive 'dat', followed by an apposition after a semicolon.
findings.evidence: left-dislocated topic (12 words) + resumptive demonstrative + semicolon apposition; no L-* threshold crossed, but the reader has to hold the topic open until 'dat spoelde'
findings.required_fix: Shorten the topic and mark the resumption: 'Het hele idee van één universum met wiskundig regelmatige wetten — dát spoelde nu door de wc. Het hele idee van \emph{natuurkunde}.'

findings.fragment: Zien: de echte wetten waren perfect universeel, ze hadden nergens een uitzondering, en ze waren simpele wiskunde voor de allerkleinste deeltjes.
findings.problem: The one-word fragment 'Zien:' is not a natural Dutch opener; a reader stumbles on it before the colon.
findings.evidence: NL 'Zien:' as a parallel to 'Ontdekken:' for EN 'finding that'; 'zien' is not used this way in Dutch
findings.required_fix: Drop 'Zien:' and continue with plain main clauses (with L1): 'De echte wetten waren overal precies hetzelfde. Ze hadden nergens een uitzondering, en ze waren simpele wiskunde voor de allerkleinste deeltjes.'

findings.fragment: de wet van behoud van energie
findings.evidence: glossary.json: 'Conservation of Energy' = 'de Wet van Behoud van Energie'
findings.required_fix: Write 'de Wet van Behoud van Energie'.

findings.fragment: kwantum-Hamiltoniaan, unitariteit, anatomie, biochemie, neurologie, neuronen
findings.problem: Flagged as unknown and as clusters, but they are deliberate opaque jargon (the set-up for 'Magie.'), all transparent cognates for an English-reading learner.
findings.evidence: vocab rows unknown, action review; clusters b028 (anatomie, biochemie, neurologie), b032 (brein, neuron); translator @notes and bible: jargon kept unglossed
findings.required_fix: No change; do not gloss. Lexicon owner: mark these as jargon so they stop counting toward density and clusters.

findings.problem: Tool-unknown but transparent: 'universum' is a cognate, 'allerkleinste' is 'aller-' + the superlative of 'klein' (A1).
findings.evidence: vocab rows universum, allerkleinst: unknown, action review
findings.required_fix: No change. Lexicon owner: add 'universum' (cognate) and let the lemmatiser strip 'aller-'.

findings.problem: Hard (B2) word, but precise and already glossed; the plain alternatives ('Het klonk echt', 'eerlijk') lose the sense of sincere.
'trillen' + 'omhoog' is an unusual pairing; the idiomatic collocation for twitching upward lips is 'omhoog trekken'.

flag_decisions.reason: Attributive adjective directly before the noun (lexicalised present participle of beslissen, A2); no participle phrase replacing a clause.
Plain attributive adjective ('gestreept', B1 in the lexicon) with no complements; a vocabulary question, handled in L3.
Demonstrative subject with the finite verb in second position ('dat is …') after a fronted noun phrase: a main clause, not a relative clause (verb would be final).
Perfectum with zijn of the intransitive 'veranderen in' (A-PERF); no agent, no 'worden'.

flag_decisions.span: , dat spoelde nu weg door de wc
flag_decisions.reason: Resumptive demonstrative after a left-dislocated topic, finite verb in second position: a legal main clause. Its heaviness is a load question (L12), not a relative clause.
Attributive adjective in the fixed phrase 'een vallende appel'; no complements, no clause replaced.

flag_decisions.span: kan zich niet zomaar de hele anatomie van een kat voorstellen
flag_decisions.reason: Nine words inside the frame and the list continues after 'voorstellen'; see L2.

tool_feedback.reason: 'gestreepte' is the adjective 'gestreept' (B1, present in the lexicon), not a verb 'streepen'.
'aller-' + superlative of 'klein' (A1); strip the prefix before lookup.

A glossary term ('Faunaat-transformatie') should count as known (count_glossary_as_known); hyphenated glossary forms are not matched. The missing gloss is still a translation finding (L8), but the row should not count toward density.

tool_feedback.ref: vocab: kwantum-hamiltoniaan, unitariteit, anatomie, biochemie, neurologie, neuron (+ clusters b028, b032)
tool_feedback.reason: Deliberate opaque jargon per the bible; the tool needs a per-scene jargon list (e.g. read from @notes) so these do not drive the density, known-share and cluster verdicts.
Transparent cognates (brain, universe) absent from every list; add to the lexicon rather than report as unknown every scene.
'beslissend' is not in the lexicon but never appears in the table (mapped to 'beslissen'); harmless here, but the same mapping hides genuinely unknown adjectives (cf. 'gepast' in V3).
Glosses on aarzelde, steek, overtreden, willekeurige, uitzondering (all known) are not reported; a 'gloss on known word' row would catch gloss bloat automatically.
A single participle used attributively right before a noun, without complements, is an adjective; suppress it or keep confidence below the 0.3 ignore threshold.
When the finite verb immediately follows the pronoun (V2 order) it is a demonstrative main clause, as the tool's own note suspects; auto-dismiss or lower confidence below 0.3.
Perfectum with zijn of a mutative intransitive; a list of zijn-perfectum verbs would remove these.
